title: arenaria suffrutescens
intro: Arenaria suffrutescens, commonly known as Sea Spurge, is a type of succulent plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Sea Spurge include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
